contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ ANTONINVS PIVS AVG ; R/ PONTIF TRP VIIII COS II

Silver coin. Denarius, possibly of Commodus (175-192), possibly issue of 183-184 but not seen in RIC, possibly from an eastern mint. Obverse description: Head laureate right. Obverse inscription: ANTONINVS PIVS AVG. Reverse description: Soldier or Mars standing left, vertical spear and shield grounded left. Reverse inscription: PONTIF TRP VIIII COS II. Diameter: 18.9mm, Weight: 3.48gms, die axis: 12
